text: At N=128 the step-3000 force margin in the 6000-step runs matches the 3000-step runs to within 0.01. But in the paired N=256 6000-step arm, seed 20 has force margin 0.102 at step 3000, against 0.03-0.04 in the earlier N=256 3000-step runs. Is that N=256 discrepancy caused by run-to-run nondeterminism or by an N-dependent lr-schedule effect? Rerunning the N=256 seed-20 3000-step config would tell these apart.
